pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar sitting beside a round brown nut on a dusty path.
Fig the caterpillar patting the brown nut gently with its front end.
The brown nut resting in a patch of dark mud beside the path.

Fig the caterpillar digging deeper into the mud, only its back end showing.
Fig the caterpillar pulling the brown nut free from the mud.
